message: feat: background/detached sub-agents — run_in_background on the task tool, task_output/task_kill to poll/abort, Ctrl+B to background a running agent, and idle completion nudges; plus fixes making backgrounded agents fully quiet — is_ui_busy split stops the comet shimmer on 'ready', IPC diff suppression ends the per-step redraw lag and chat-rams-to-bottom, and live_text streams the report into the $ viewer; never-empty reports (reasoning fallback), no double-report (altitude-aware stall detection), recovery of backend-dropped tool-call args from inline XML, and the explore step cap raised 15 to 80.
